user_query: My family and I are planning a vacation in Japan. Can you fetch the currency conversion rates from USD to JPY and provide me with the historical rates for the past two weeks? Also, find the market details of the JPY/USD market and flip a coin to decide our itinerary.

TaskList.description: Fetch the current currency conversion rate from USD to JPY.
Fetch the historical currency conversion rates from USD to JPY for the past two weeks.
Find the market details of the JPY/USD currency market.
Flip a coin to decide the itinerary.
